Sign in to Accent with an account email and password. Accent itself authenticates via OAuth (GitHub/Google), but this environment models a session account by its User email and a password value; every project-scoped operation needs this session open, because that is what `$actor` resolves to for permission checks.

messages.required: Both an email and a password are required to sign in.

_evidence.note: Real repo logs in via OAuth callback (AuthProvider by uid+provider). Modeled as email/password session for the runtime; auth_callback was renamed to sign_in.

summary: Accent is a self-hosted translation-management platform (Phoenix/Elixir + Ecto/Postgres + GraphQL + REST): lets users create projects, revisions per language, documents, versions and translations, review and correct translation strings, manage collaborator roles, comment on translations, configure integrations (slack/discord/Azure/AWS-S3), API tokens, prompts, machine-translation and lint rules, and sync/merge translation files over HTTP. All entities are persisted Ecto tables; mutation/read operations are exposed via GraphQL and REST controllers, with Oban async workers for hooks and deletions.
